project.name: Selemene Engine Admin Panel and Supabase Upgrades
assumptions: A new web admin app will be created at apps/admin-web because no web frontend exists today.
Root migrations/ is the canonical migration source; supabase/migrations/ must be reconciled to avoid drift.
Admin APIs will be served from noesis-api under /api/v1/admin/*.
Auth for admin web will use short-lived access tokens and a secure refresh/session strategy.
Supabase Postgres remains the source of truth for users, keys, readings, and usage data.
risks: Dual migration trees can break deploys or produce inconsistent schemas.
RBAC helpers exist but are not currently enforced in API route guards.
API key revoke currently has in-memory behavior that can diverge from DB state.
usage_logs partitioning is pre-created only for 2026 and can fail in future periods.
RLS rollout can accidentally block service/admin flows if introduced too early.

phases.name: Wave 0 - Architecture and Safety Baseline
phases.objective: Resolve foundational decisions and known data correctness issues before feature implementation.

sprints.focus: Planning integrity, migration strategy, RBAC scope, and admin IA contracts.

tasks.title: Select canonical migration source and drift policy
tasks.deliverable: Signed migration strategy document declaring root migrations/ as canonical and Supabase alignment rules.
tasks.acceptance: A documented decision exists and CI/deploy docs reference exactly one migration authority.

tasks.title: Patch progression_logs UUID default defect
tasks.deliverable: Migration that sets default UUID generation for progression_logs.id and validates inserts.
tasks.acceptance: Insert path for progression logs succeeds without passing explicit id in integration test.

tasks.title: Define RBAC matrix for admin panel operations
tasks.deliverable: Permission matrix covering roles and actions for keys, users, sync, billing, and audit views.
tasks.acceptance: Every planned admin endpoint and page maps to one explicit permission check.

tasks.title: Define admin information architecture and route contracts
tasks.deliverable: Route map and page contracts for login, dashboard, users, keys, history, analytics, system, and audit pages.
tasks.acceptance: Route map is reviewed and includes data dependencies and required API endpoints per page.

tasks.title: Write ADR for web stack and session strategy
tasks.deliverable: ADR selecting admin-web stack, API client approach, and token/session lifecycle model.
tasks.acceptance: ADR is approved and referenced by backend and frontend implementation tasks.

phases.name: Wave 1 - Data Foundation
phases.objective: Create a reliable schema base for admin lifecycle operations, sync, and analytics.

sprints.focus: Supabase drift cleanup plus admin/sync/billing schema additions.

tasks.title: Reconcile supabase/migrations with canonical schema
tasks.deliverable: Supabase migration set aligned with root migrations and duplicate/example drift removed.
tasks.acceptance: Fresh database bootstrap produces schema expected by repositories without manual fixes.

tasks.title: Add user_roles and user_account_state tables
tasks.deliverable: Role and account-state schema with constraints, indexes, and backfill migration.
tasks.acceptance: Role assignment and account suspension state can be queried and updated transactionally.

tasks.title: Add api_key_events and key metadata columns
tasks.deliverable: Schema support for key creation/revoke/rotate events and actor attribution.
tasks.acceptance: Each key lifecycle action can persist immutable audit rows with indexed lookups.

tasks.title: Add history sync tables and idempotency columns
tasks.deliverable: readings sync columns plus user_devices and history_sync_state tables with unique idempotency index.
tasks.acceptance: Duplicate client_event_id write for same user is idempotent and cursor delta queries are possible.

tasks.title: Add plan catalog and billing subscription schema
tasks.deliverable: Plan and subscription tables with status constraints and provider identifiers.
tasks.acceptance: User can be resolved to an active plan through schema-level joins without duplicated tier ambiguity.

tasks.title: Implement usage partition maintenance function
tasks.deliverable: DB function/job that ensures usage_logs partitions exist for future months.
tasks.acceptance: Automated check creates missing upcoming partitions and alerts on failure.

phases.name: Wave 2 - Backend Admin and Key Lifecycle APIs
phases.objective: Deliver secure admin APIs for keys, users, and history sync with enforced RBAC and auditability.

sprints.focus: Service-layer lifecycle logic, RBAC wiring, and admin HTTP routes.

tasks.title: Implement secure API key generator service
tasks.deliverable: Service that generates prefixed keys, stores only hashed values, and supports one-time plaintext reveal.
tasks.acceptance: Generated key is returned once, stored hashed, and can authenticate subsequent requests.

tasks.title: Implement API key lifecycle operations in repository/service
tasks.deliverable: Lifecycle methods for list, revoke, rotate, expiry updates, and cache invalidation.
tasks.acceptance: Revoked keys fail auth immediately and rotated keys preserve auditable lineage.

tasks.title: Implement centralized admin audit event service
tasks.deliverable: Shared audit writer that captures actor, action, target, request_id, and request metadata.
tasks.acceptance: All admin mutating endpoints emit structured audit events with consistent schema.

tasks.title: Enforce RBAC middleware and route guards
tasks.deliverable: Middleware/guard layer enforcing role and permission checks on admin routes.
tasks.acceptance: Unauthorized principals receive 403 and authorized principals succeed across admin APIs.

tasks.title: Add admin API key endpoints
tasks.deliverable: HTTP endpoints for create/list/revoke/rotate key operations under /api/v1/admin/api-keys.
tasks.acceptance: OpenAPI and integration tests cover happy path and permission-denied behavior for key lifecycle.

tasks.title: Add admin user management endpoints
tasks.deliverable: Endpoints for user list/search/detail and admin actions (suspend, tier update, role assign).
tasks.acceptance: Admin can manage user state through API and all mutations are audited.

tasks.title: Add history sync admin and service endpoints
tasks.deliverable: Cursor-based sync endpoints and admin visibility endpoints for sync/device state.
tasks.acceptance: Delta sync and device cursor inspection work with idempotent writes and predictable pagination.

phases.name: Wave 3 - Admin Web Foundation
phases.objective: Establish a production-ready web admin foundation with secure auth, typed API access, and reusable UI primitives.

sprints.focus: Scaffold app, secure routing/auth, and baseline dashboard capabilities.

tasks.title: Scaffold apps/admin-web with React TypeScript toolchain
tasks.deliverable: New admin web app package with build, lint, test, and local dev scripts.
tasks.acceptance: Admin app starts locally and passes baseline lint/typecheck in CI.

tasks.title: Implement protected app shell and route groups
tasks.deliverable: Layout with sidebar/topbar, protected routes, and role-aware navigation.
tasks.acceptance: Unauthenticated users are redirected to login and role-restricted links are hidden or blocked.

tasks.title: Implement auth session UX
tasks.deliverable: Login/logout/session refresh flow with expiry handling and secure token storage strategy.
tasks.acceptance: Session survives refresh correctly and expires gracefully with explicit re-auth path.

tasks.title: Generate typed API client and data access layer
tasks.deliverable: OpenAPI-generated client and query/mutation hooks for admin APIs.
tasks.acceptance: All admin pages consume typed hooks and compile-time errors surface contract drift.

tasks.title: Build shared admin UI primitives
tasks.deliverable: Reusable table, filter bar, drawer, modal form, toast, and permission-badge components.
tasks.acceptance: Primary admin pages can be built with primitives without bespoke table/form rewrites.

tasks.title: Build admin dashboard overview page
tasks.deliverable: Dashboard page showing health, key usage metrics, and recent admin activity feed.
tasks.acceptance: Dashboard renders live backend data and degrades gracefully when one data source is unavailable.

phases.name: Wave 4 - Admin Feature Pages
phases.objective: Deliver complete page-level functionality for key management, users, history sync, analytics, system state, and audits.

tasks.title: Build API Keys management page
tasks.deliverable: Page for key list/create/revoke/rotate with one-time key reveal UX and confirmation flows.
tasks.acceptance: Admin can execute full key lifecycle from UI and observe immediate state changes.

tasks.title: Build Users management page
tasks.deliverable: Page for user search/detail, suspension state, tier updates, and role assignment.
tasks.acceptance: User state updates from UI persist to backend and audit events are visible.

tasks.title: Build User History Sync page
tasks.deliverable: Page showing per-user sync cursors, device state, and history ingestion diagnostics.
tasks.acceptance: Operators can identify out-of-sync users and inspect cursor progression without database access.

tasks.title: Build Usage Analytics page
tasks.deliverable: Charts/tables for usage by day, engine, workflow, user tier, and key.
tasks.acceptance: Admin can filter usage windows and exported totals match backend aggregates.

tasks.title: Build System Operations page
tasks.deliverable: Operational page surfacing API health, TS bridge availability, workflow success/failure snapshots, and cache state.
tasks.acceptance: Operators can identify degraded subsystems and jump to the affected service quickly.

tasks.title: Build Audit Trail page
tasks.deliverable: Auditable event feed with filters by actor/action/target and CSV export.
tasks.acceptance: Every key and user admin action appears in audit view with traceable metadata.

phases.name: Wave 5 - Hardening, Testing, and Launch
phases.objective: Lock security and reliability, validate end-to-end behavior, and launch with rollback safety.

sprints.focus: Security controls, full test matrix, and production rollout gates.

tasks.title: Roll out RLS policies and verification harness
tasks.deliverable: RLS policies for self/admin/service access with automated verification scripts.
tasks.acceptance: Service role and admin role pass required queries while unauthorized access is denied.

tasks.title: Add backend integration tests for admin lifecycle APIs
tasks.deliverable: Integration test suite covering RBAC, key lifecycle, user updates, sync endpoints, and audit emissions.
tasks.acceptance: CI passes deterministic tests for positive and negative authorization scenarios.

tasks.title: Add frontend E2E tests for critical admin flows
tasks.deliverable: E2E scenarios for login, create/revoke key, suspend user, and audit verification.
tasks.acceptance: Playwright/Cypress suite runs green in CI and blocks merges on critical flow failures.

tasks.title: Finalize CI/CD, runbooks, and staged launch
tasks.deliverable: Release checklist, rollback plan, feature flags, and staged rollout plan for admin panel enablement.
tasks.acceptance: Deployment playbook is executed in staging and production launch gates are documented and test-backed.
